assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: GAME TURN-TABLE SPRITE ATLAS, one single device in eight yaw orientations, exact 4 columns x 2 rows equal cells on a genuinely transparent 1536x1024 canvas. No text, labels, borders, ground, shadows outside object or checkerboard. Every sprite centered on same fixed bottom pedestal point with generous transparent padding, fits its own cell. CAMERA FIXED in all cells: 60 degrees above horizontal ground (=30 degrees away from straight overhead), looking from south toward north. Not a 30 degree elevation isometric camera. A physically upright machine stands on the horizontal ground, its vertical panels stay vertical, never lay the machine on its back. Only turn the machine around the vertical world axis; do NOT rotate flat 2D copies in screen space. Exact eight forward headings in reading order: E, SE, S toward viewer, SW, W, NW, N away from viewer, NE. Genuine corresponding front, rear and side surfaces; no identical views repeated. Same geometry, size, colors, globally fixed upper-left lighting. Highly polished vivid stylized mobile-game painted 3D illustration, crisp dark outline, silver bevel highlights, no photorealism. Reference is identity/material/palette reference, NOT layout/camera to copy. Red and silver compact LASER CANNON on a short swiveling pedestal. One horizontal barrel, bright small round red/orange muzzle, same reference details. Horizontal bore points exactly toward E SE S SW W NW N NE in order. Fixed short pedestal points straight down, never flip the pedestal. True side E and W silhouettes (no false 3/4 side), S front centered muzzle, N rear cooling plate hiding muzzle. CAMERA: high-angle camera 60 degrees above floor; show top surfaces generously, short upright vertical sides. This is an asset atlas not a presentation poster. Each view in exactly equal cell, separate fully visible. All empty canvas truly transparent.
